questions.explanation: Ignoring the padded distractors: Metallic bonding is the electrostatic attraction between the positively charged atomic nuclei of metal atoms and the sea of delocalized electrons in the metal. This free movement of electrons is exactly why metals are universally excellent conductors of heat and electricity.
